entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Mana Break reduces Snapfire's already low mana pool.
Blink allows Anti-Mage to avoid being hit by Lil' Shredder and Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Global Silence stops Snapfire's Mortimer Kisses.
Last Word can prevent Snapfire from casting additional spells.

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: Spiked Carapace stops Snapfire's Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Ice Blast, Cold Feet, and Ice Vortex are easier to land on Snapfire while she channels her Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Blade Fury makes Juggernaut immune against all of Snapfire's spells and allows him to get closer.
A well-timed Omnislash allows Juggernaut to dodge Snapfire's spells, and she has no way to deal with it.

entries.name: Abaddon
lines: Aphotic Shield prevents damage and dispels the slow from Snapfire's Mortimer Kisses.
Borrowed Time allows Abaddon to gain HP during Snapfire's Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Meat Hook can be used immediately after Mortimer Kisses since Snapfire is forced to stay in place.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Storm Hammer stunned can stops Snapfire's Mortimer Kisses.
Heroes with mobility spells (such as Queen of Pain_new's Blink and Clockwerk with Hookshot) can easily avoid Lil' Shredder and Mortimer Kisses.
Blade Mail is easy to time against Lil' Shredder and Mortimer Kisses, due to their slow and gradual damage output.
Black King Bar can simply protect you against all of Snapfire's spells.
Diffusal Blade reduces Snapfire's already low mana pool and the slow prevents her from escaping easily.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Mortimer Kisses will quickly destroy Chen's creeps and might waste Hand of God.

entries.name: Clockwerk
lines: Firesnap Cookie can be fed to Snapfire herself or to an ally caught inside Power Cogs.
A badly placed Power Cog makes it easier for Snapfire to aim Mortimer Kisses on Clockwerk

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Snapfire's AoE abilities in general are effective in clearing Phantom Lancer's illusions.

entries.name: Phoenix
lines: Lil' Shredder will make quick work of Supernova.
Mortimer Kisses can easily hit a Phoenix using Sun Ray.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Mortimer Kisses can reduce Omniknight's impact in teamfights. Omniknight's Heavenly Grace cannot purge multiple stacks of Mortimer Kisses. The damage is also magical, making Omniknight's ultimate, Guardian Angel, useless.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Mortimer Kisses can deal a large amount of damage to Void during Chronosphere, either outright killing him or forcing him out before he can kill any allies caught in his ultimate.
Heroes reliant on illusions or summons: Broodmother, Holy Knight, Naga Siren.
Heroes with summons that are destroyed by a fixed number of attacks: Undying's Tombstone, Gyrocopter's Homing Missile, and Thor's Nimbus.

entries.name: Clockwerk
lines: Power Cogs provides a simple setup for Mortimer Kisses
Rocket Flare can spot enemy heroes inside Roshan's Pit, where Snapfire can cast Mortimer Kisses to force them to scatter away of it
Firesnap Cookie can be used to give Clockwerk a long distance push.
Gobble Up can throw Clockwerk directly on top of an enemy hero, or it can be used to save him from a bad engagement (requires Aghanim's Scepter)

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Chronosphere sets up a great opportunity to combo with Mortimer Kisses.
Time Lock helps lock down target for Snapfire to attack.
Time Walk can be used with Firesnap Cookie to give Faceless Void a long distance push.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Fortune's End can be used on Snapfire to root enemies after she jumps in with Firesnap Cookie.
Fate's Edict and False Promise protects Snapfire against magic damage while she channels Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Warlock
lines: Upheaval keeps enemies in place for Snapfire to hit with Mortimer Kisses.

entries.name: Mars
lines: Arena Of Blood keeps many enemies in place for easy Mortimer Kisses.
Play makers(Earthshaker, Enigma, Pantheon etc) can make great use of Spit Out and initiate a fight from afar.
Heroes with abilities that slow, stun or root enemies will make them easy targets for Mortimer Kisses: Magnus, Enigma, Earthshaker, Earth Spirit, Keeper of the Light, Tidehunter, Kunkka.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango keeps Snapfire's HP up in lane.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve gives you a burst of healing to get back up to full in laning phase.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango lets you cast more spells in the lane.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity is a cheap way to refill your mana when you have a break from the fighting.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed for movement speed.

entries.name: Infused Raindrops
lines: Infused Raindrops for mana regen and to block magical damage.

entries.name: Headdress
lines: Headdress is a great sustain item in dual lanes. It also builds into Mekansm.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots provides mana for Snapfire and her teammates.

entries.name: Mekansm
lines: Mekansm keeps Snapfire and teammates alive in teamfight.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger offers mobility,as Snapfire is a particularly slow moving hero.

entries.name: Guardian Greaves
lines: Guardian Greaves provides great sustain for teamfighting and pushing.

entries.name: Glimmer Cape
lines: Glimmer Cape can hide Snapfire while she is channeling her ultimate.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff gets Snapfire and her teammates into position.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard gives Snapfire extra AOE-stun at very low cost.

entries.name: Desolator
lines: Desolator is an item that enhances Lil' Shredder and works with a semi-carry core build.

entries.name: Javelin
lines: Javelin gives each Lil' Shredder chance to deal extra damage at a very low price. Multiple Javelins stack to increase proc chance during Lil' Shredder.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse gives you an amazing disable, but is very expensive.

entries.name: Vladmir's Offering
lines: Vladmir's Offering gives your team a powerful lifesteal aura.

playstyle.text: Snapfire is a heavily armed nuker capable of dishing out high damage with Scatterblast and Lil' Shredder. She also provides some mobility and support for her team by tossing them Firesnap Cookies. With the help of her mount Mortimer, Snapfire's ultimate can barrage foes from extreme distances, covering the ground in flames. Most of her abilities will slow enemies, but she suffers from mana problems as well as long cooldowns in the early game.
cons: Ultimate reduces turn rate and has a minimum fire range.

lines: Snapfire is usually played as a position 4 or 5 support,as her toolkit is powerful in the early game and allows harassment in lane.With Multiple Clarity potions,you can cast Scatterblast and force enemies to back off.If the core has an easy lane,you can choose to gang the midlane early and establish control.

Snapfire has strong burst damage in lane, but her low armor and mediocre attack range make it hard to trade against enemy supports. Try to set up kills by comboing your abilities with your lane partner whenever you can.

When you reach level 6, look for opportunities to use Mortimer Kisses to get kills and turn fights for your team. Figure out who you can play with to get a kill, and use your ultimate as soon as possible to put it on cooldown. Snapfire's biggest strength is in her ultimate, so you don't want to be sitting around passively while your ultimate is off cooldown.

When Mortimer Kisses isn't up, you can play away from your team and push out waves. Do not take 5 on 5 teamfights without your ultimate. Alt-click on your ability to let your team know if your ultimate is not ready for the upcoming fight.

Snapfire doesn't require any specific items to get good value out of her abilities, so she makes an excellent support. If you do get a significant amount of gold and experience however, Snapfire makes for an ideal aura carrier because of her high strength gain.
A close range Scatterblast is one of the hardest hitting abilities in the early game.
Can be used to farm jungle or push waves. Combined with Firesnap Cookies, you can clear a creep wave in one round of spells.
The projectiles from Scatterblast travel much further than the targeting range. To hit an enemy at max range, you may need to ground target the spell.
Scatterblast also applies a strong but short-lasting movement speed and attack speed slow, potentially disrupting and escaping the enemy's gank attempts or help your team chase fleeing enemies.
Hitting multiple heroes in one cast will greatly increase the damage efficiency of this ability.
Use Scatterblast to guarantee last hits, gaining gold and harass the enemy in one cast.
Firesnap Cookie will make the target leap forward in the direction they are facing when the cookie hits them. Be aware that if your ally turns at the last second, your stun can miss.
Having good team coordination and communication is recommended, as to avoid pushing an unwilling ally into danger or accidentally pushing an ally in an unintended direction.
Use Firesnap Cookie to boost Snapfire or an ally over impassable terrain.

Use Firesnap Cookie on creeps in lane for a surprise stun. This is especially effective if the enemy was trying to deny the last creep in a wave, because they will tank your creep wave while they are stunned.
If the ally is too far to be thrown a Cookie at, consider using it on yourself or any other ally closer to the enemy to stun them and let your endangered ally escape.
Lil' Shredder is Snapfire's most consistent source of physical damage, provided that her target stays in range for her to land all six shots.
The increased attack speed and range makes it easy to destroy units that require a fixed number of attacks to destroy, such as Supernova, Tombstone, or Homing Missile.
Lil' Shredder always applies the same amount of armor reduction regardless of its level, making it a good harassment tool early-game or assist in killing enemies faster.
If laning against heroes with low armor, buying Blight Stone will further increase the damage of Lil' Shredder early game.
Lil' Shredder can activate items like Diffusal Blade and Maelstrom with every individual hit.
Multiple hits of Mortimer Kisses will deal very high damage, but its slow projectile speed makes it hard to land.
Use it on stunned, rooted or slowed enemies for an easy kill.
If Snapfire needs to move, Mortimer Kisses can be stopped mid-channel by pressing S.
Use Mortimer Kisses across terrain, over trees and high ground to clear out enemies. It is especially useful for sieging tier 3 towers.
Remember that Mortimer Kisses has a minimum range of 600, meaning that it cannot hit enemies close to Snapfire, especially melee attackers.
Mortimer Kisses will also reduce Snapfire's turn rate, which can prevent her from hitting an opponent with fast movement speed or high mobility.
Mortimer Kisses will give you vision at each targeting circle. When the enemy runs away, this vision combined with the slow can make it impossible for the enemy to escape.

Allies with powerful AoE abilities are Snapfire's best partners in teamfights. Coordinate with Reverse Polarity, Black Hole, or Chronosphere to catch as many enemy heroes as you can and deal massive damage to the enemy with little to no retaliation.

Roshan's pit is a deadly place for the enemy to be caught by Mortimer Kisses. If your team suspects that the enemy may be attacking Roshan, or are bound to do so soon, save the ability for the proper time to punish the enemy's attempts at killing him.

bio:
Beatrix Snapfire and her dragon toad Mortimer are a welcome sight to the ragged folk who scratch out lives along the desert routes and oases scattered throughout Nanarak, the rain-forsaken gateway to the Outlands.

As well known for her unrivaled skills as a weaponsmith as for dispensing wisdom, mirth, and the meanest firesnap cookies the world has ever seen, Beadie's survived to a ripe old age in a young keen's trade by being quick with her wits and even quicker with her guns.

Indeed, the Outlands are littered with the bones of bandits and ne'er-do-wells who thought to take advantage of her small stature and propensity for kindness.
trivia: Snapfire is likely based on early concepts of a unreleased hero "Mortar Team" developed during the DotA era.
"Say hello to my little friend!" is a reference to Tony Montana's line from the movie "Scarface".
"This here's my boomstick" is a reference to Ash's line from "Army of Darkness".
"I love the smell of black powder in the morning" is a reference to Lieutenant Colonel Bill Kilgore's line from "Apocalypse Now ".
"Oh give me a home, where the wildwings roam..." is a reference to the Western folk song "Home on the Range".
Snapfire's voice actress, "Laraine Newman", was a character in the 1993 movie "Coneheads", which explain the responses to Dark Seer as references to said movie.

wikiNotes.text: Scatterblast travels at a speed of 3000, taking 0.27 seconds to travel the full distance.
With the travel distance and end radius, it can hit units up to 1200 range away.
The complete area is shaped like a cone.
Scatterblast's damage is determined upon projectile hit, and not upon cast.
It has a custom ability targeting indicator and the damage dealt is determined by two cones, with the darker color cone indicating the point-blank damage distance, and the remaining cone distance.
Cast range bonuses only increases the arc length and reduce the angle of the cone. It neither increases the point-blank distance, nor the remaining cone distance.
Deals 150/240/330/420 (255/345/435/525) damage (before reductions) to units within point-blank distance.
Leveling up Scatterblast, or learning the damage increasing talent does not update the damage of an already launched instance.
Scatterblast first applies the damage, then the movement speed slow.

abilities.description: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by 25% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by 50% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
abilities.name: Scatterblast

wikiNotes.text: ↓↓ Double-tapping automatically target self.
Has a 0.3+0 cast animation when cast on self.
The projectile travels at a speed of 1100.
Cannot be cast on allied units that are currently channeling. This includes self-casting.
Cannot be cast on invulnerable and hidden units.
If the ally starts channeling, turns invulnerable, or is hidden after the projectile launch, the projectile does nothing upon impact.
Can target, but has no effect on units affected by Chronosphere and Black Hole, the projectile does nothing on impact.
Upon projectile impact, the target jumps 425 (600) range forwards and 257 (362) range upwards. While in the air, other units can pass below them.
During the jump, the target is fully disabled and prevented from acting.
Can jump over other units and over impassable terrain.
The area damage and stun are applied upon losing the hop buff. This means if the leap gets interrupted, the effects are applied earlier.
Firesnap Cookie first applies the heal, then the damage, then the stun, then the Mortimer Kisses debuff.
The health restore talent immediately upgrades already launched cookies, making them heal on impact.
Destroys trees within 300 radius around the target upon landing.

upon cast landing the unit deals one instance of impact damage based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, and leaves a lava puddle behind. The puddle applies the debuff in 0.5-second intervals, starting immediately and lasts for 3 seconds.
Mortimer Kisses notes fully apply. If it is not learned, no glob is launched.

Firesnap Cookie can deal up to the following amount of impact damage and total damage per second (before reductions) per level of Mortimer Kisses, considering its impact damage, and standing within the puddle for the full duration:
The projectile provides 500 radius flying vision as it travels. This vision lingers for 3.5 seconds at the impact area.
Since Firesnap Cookie, Spit Out and Mortimer Kisses use the same modifer, they do not stack, with the damage from the first applied debuff taking priority.

abilities.description: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
abilities.name: Firesnap Cookie
abilities.shard: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does 40% impact damage to the landing destination.

wikiNotes.text: Interrupts Snapfire's channeling abilities on cast.
Increases Snapfire's attack range to 575/650/725/800, and sets her base attack time to 1.
Sets Snapfire's damage to the given values, attack damage bonuses, and reductions are completely ignored.
This restriction is removed with the Lil' Shredder uses attack damage talent.
Leveling up Lil' Shredder or learning the talent does not update the damage of the currently active instance.
An attack charge is lost whenever an attack is executed, regardless of the outcome. This means missed attacks use up charges as well.
The number of charges left is visible on the buff icon.
Lil' Shredder uses a single debuff on the target. Following attacks increase its stack count.
A number on the icon reveals the number of stacks. The number is visible to everyone.
Since only one debuff is used, each attack resets the duration of the entire stack.
The armor reduction is applied on any attacked target, including buildings and allies.
Can deal a total of 180/330/480/630 (240/440/640/840) damage with all 6 (8) attacks (before reductions).
Can reduce a total of 3 (4) armor with all attacks.
The attacks first place the debuff, then apply their own damage.
Since the Lil' Shredder debuff is applied before the damage, the ability's damage benefits from the armor reduction applied.
Successive casts do not stack but refresh the buff, resetting the number of attacks and updating the attack range bonus.
The multishot talent performs instant attacks on 3 different random targets within attack range whenever attacking during Lil' Shredder.
These instant attacks can proc any attack modifiers and on-hit effects normally. They do not have True Strike, and are affected by disarms.
The secondary attacks have no target priorities, they choose random valid targets within range, excluding buildings.
The secondary attacks' search radius can be further increased by other attack range bonuses.

notes: Sets base attack time to 1s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.
abilities.description: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire 5 attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
abilities.name: Lil' Shredder

wikiNotes.text: Requires Aghanim's Scepter to be unlocked.
Can be cast on any unit, except for enemy heroes, ancient creeps and creep-heroes.
Cannot be cast on allies who have ☐ Disabled Help from Snapfire.
Disjoints projectiles for the target unit upon cast.
The target unit is invulnerable, hidden, silenced, muted, and disarmed while swallowed.
During Gobble Up, the unit is periodically moved to Snapfire's current position. This periodic movement cannot be interrupted.
This means their auras are effectively bestowed around Snapfire until spat out.
The unit is automatically released after 3 seconds if Spit Out is not cast.
If the unit is an enemy or neutral creep, Gobble Up changes the targeted creep's owner to Snapfire and instantly kills it in the form of HP Removal when released, this effectively deniesing it.
The damage dealt can be defined as 100% × CurrentHP
Treats illusions and clones as heroes.
Swallowing a unit turns this ability inactive and turns the Spit Out sub-ability active.
This ability stays inactive until the unit is released, either by timing out, by using the sub-ability, or upon Snapfire's death.

notes: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.
abilities.description: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to ? seconds.
abilities.name: Gobble Up

wikiNotes.text: Requires Aghanim's Scepter to be unlocked.
This ability stays inactive until Gobble Up is cast and turns inactive again once the targeted unit is spat out in any way.
The swallowed unit serves as a projectile, and is moved in an arc towards the targeted point, with a max height of 130.
The projectile has a min and max travel time of 0.6 – 2.1 seconds respectively, and a projectile speed of 1400.
This means up to 2333 range, the speed adapts to lower values, and for distance starting at 2940, the speed adapts to higher values.
While flying, the unit is stunned, invulnerable and hidden.
Upon landing, if the unit is an enemy or neutral creep, it instantly kills it in the form of HP Removal.
The damage dealt can be defined as 100% × CurrentHP
Treats illusions and clones as heroes.
Neither requires Mortimer Kisses to be leveled to be unlocked nor relies on Mortimer Kisses to work, once Aghanim's Scepter is acquired.
Upon landing, the unit deals one instance of impact damage based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, and leaves a lava puddle behind. The puddle lasts 3 seconds.
The puddle applies the debuff on enemies in 0.5-second intervals, starting immediately as it is created, resulting in 7 instances.
The debuff lasts 1 second, and deals 50 damage in 0.5-second intervals, starting immediately upon being placed, resulting in 3 instances.
Can deal a total of 630/720/810 (690/780/870) damage, considering impact damage, and standing within the puddle for the full duration (before reductions).
Multiple instances of the debuff do not stack.
Since Firesnap Cookie, Spit Out and Mortimer Kisses use the same modifer, they do not stack, with the damage from the first applied debuff taking priority.
The impact first applies the damage, then the stun.
Spit Out has no minimum distance.
The projectile provides 500 radius flying vision as it travels. This vision lingers for 3.5 seconds at the impact area.
Destroys trees within 150 radius around the projectile upon landing.

abilities.description: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
abilities.name: Spit Out

wikiNotes.text: The projectiles have a min and max travel time of 0.8 – 2 seconds respectively, and a projectile speed of 1300.
This means up to 1625 range, the speed adapts to lower values, and for distance starting at 2600, the speed adapts to higher values.
Launches globs in 0.688 (0.393)-second intervals, starting immediately upon cast, resulting in 8 (14) globs.
Mortimer Kisses is not a channeling ability. It can only be interrupted in the following conditions:
When Snapfire is affected by silence, cyclone, hex, sleep, taunt, or fear sources.
When other orders, except for attack and movement orders, are given to Snapfire.
Stun sources using the modifier_stunned reliably interrupt Mortimer Kisses.
Other disabling sources (e.g. forced movement from enemies) may interrupt Mortimer Kisses only if the disabling duration is greater than the intervals between two launched globs.
Therefore, neither teleport sources nor being affected by the following abilities cancel Mortimer Kisses.
Glimpse, Return or Nether Swap.
Firesnap Cookie does not cancel Mortimer Kisses if it was cast by an ally.
The following effects are applied on Snapfire while Mortimer Kisses are active:
Sets Snapfire's movement speed to 0 (has priority over hastes) and disarms Snapfire for its duration, so it cannot move or attack.
Attack orders behave like move orders during disarms, Right Click on an enemy sets a new location as well.
Reduces Snapfire's turn rate to 0.15 while launching globs.
The location for the globs can be changed with a move order (Right Click or M).
The destination for each glob is marked with a red circle indicator, which is visible to allies only.
Although the ability reduces Snapfire's turn rate while active, the globs are launched where the order was targeted, they are not launched based on facing angle.
Each glob deals the impact damage and leaves a lava puddle behind. The puddles last 3 seconds.
The puddles apply the debuff on enemies in 0.5-second intervals, starting immediately as they are created, resulting in 7 instances.
The debuff lasts 1 second, and deals 30/40/50 damage in 0.5-second intervals, starting immediately upon being placed, resulting in 3 instances.
Multiple instances of the debuff do not stack.
Since Firesnap Cookie, Spit Out and Mortimer Kisses use the same modifer, they do not stack, with the damage from the first applied debuff taking priority.
A single glob can deal a total of 450/630/810 (510/690/870) damage, considering impact damage, and standing within the puddle for the full duration (before reductions).
Provides 275 radius flying vision at the current targeted location for the globs, lasting until Mortimer stops launching projectiles.
The projectiles provide a 500 radius flying vision as they travel. This vision lingers for 3.5 seconds at the impact area.
Leveling up Mortimer Kisses does not update the impact damage of already launched globs.
However, the lava puddles are updated to apply the debuff with the current value.
Already placed debuffs are not updated to the current values.

notes: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of 0.8 and maximum travel time of 2.
